_comment: SYNTHETIC EXAMPLE ONLY — obviously-fake project names and topic prefixes throughout. The real topic-prefix-to-project.json carries private instance routing data (real project identifiers, real per-project topic-prefix conventions) and is gitignored, never committed. This file documents the required SHAPE and every rule-matching behavior migrate-02-decisions.js's loadRoutingMap()/classifyTopic() implement, and is also what test/migrations/test-migrate-02-decisions.js loads (via --routing-map) so the suite runs green with no private data present, in CI or anywhere else. Ordered rule list, first-match-wins. Each rule is typed LITERAL (exact match on the topic's first TWO dash-tokens) or WILDCARD (match on the topic's first dash-token only). A topic matching zero rules routes to project_id = 'unmatched-<first-dash-token>' at migration time (never guessed, never silently dropped — see the fallback proven by 'never-seen-before-topic' in the test suite). known_project_ids must contain EXACTLY every rule target used below, EXCEPT the 'unmatched-*' bucket targets and the dynamic 'unmatched-<first-dash-token>' fallback, which are deliberately never real project_ids — loadRoutingMap() FAILs loud at load time (D-12) otherwise. documentary_baseline_by_hint/documentary_total are OPTIONAL — a diagnostic-only, never-a-gate stale-count comparison (D-9); omitted here since there is no real history behind a synthetic map, but present on the real, private file.

rules.note: example row 1 — main literal prefix for proj-alpha
example row 2 -- scan-tooling, same tool family as proj-alpha, different literal prefix folding into the same target
example row 3 -- QA-target singleton, same tool family as proj-alpha
example row 4 -- same tool family as proj-alpha
example row 5 -- literal prefix need not textually resemble its target
example row 6 -- wildcard on prefix, not literal-string match; every gamma-* topic routes here regardless of the second token (e.g. gamma-judge routes to proj-gamma, NOT a separate 'judge' project)
example row 9 -- literal prefix need not textually resemble its target
unmatched-by-wildcard singleton example, owner-review — NEVER auto-routed to any low-confidence inferred project; D-2
